chunks: A number of our companions, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from Muʿāwiyah ibn Wahb, from Saʿīd al-Sammān, who said:
I heard Abū ʿAbdillāh (ṣalawātullāh ʿalayh) saying:

Indeed, the likeness of the weapon among us is like the Ark among the Children of Israel. Among the Children of Israel, whichever household the Ark was found at their door, they were given prophethood. So whoever among us the weapon comes to, he is given the Imamate.

key_terms.التَّابُوتِ: the Ark; the sacred sign associated with divinely granted authority among Banī Isrāʾīl
key_terms.السِّلَاحِ: the weapon; a sign of authority passed among the Imams
key_terms.النُّبُوَّةَ: prophethood; divine appointment granted to chosen households
key_terms.الْإِمَامَةَ: the Imamate; divinely bestowed leadership in the Ahl al-Bayt
key_terms.بَنِي إِسْرَائِيلَ: the Children of Israel; the earlier community used here for comparison

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith explain the sign of Imamate among the Ahl al-Bayt?
ai.summary: This hadith draws an analogy between the weapon inherited within the Ahl al-Bayt and the Ark among the Children of Israel as a sign of divinely designated authority. It presents the transfer of the weapon as an indicator of Imamate, just as the Ark signified sacred authority among earlier communities.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Muawiya Bin Wahab, from Saeed Al Samman who said,

‘But rather, and example of the weapons among us<sup>asws</sup> is an example of the Ark among the Children of Israel. The Children of Israel were such that whichever family the Ark was found to be upon their door, were Given the Prophet-hood. So the one<sup>asws</sup> from us<sup>asws</sup> to whom the weapons come to be, is Given the Imamate’.
en.sarwar: 1. A number of our people has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Mu’awiya ibn Wahab from Sa‘id al-Samman who has said that he heard abu ‘Abdallah (a.s.) say the following.
“The case of the Armaments with us is like the case of the Ark with Israelites.
